name: Kalam: reconcile this node's model set
description: Every version the ladder says is verified or active, registered, admitted and activated ON THIS NODE. Models are a state-database entity and each replica is its own Orion with its own state database, so a roster is per node -- and a clock that reconciles from Soma's gate (`GET /v1/runner/roster`, which is also the liveness check) needs no replica list anywhere, which is what keeps any clock from ever calling a replica. One step per item per tick: registration queues admission, and a later tick activates what passed. Nothing here writes to the platform schema; the runner holds no database credential.

setup.name: What the ladder says this node should be able to play
Warn when the roster outgrows the loop
setup.description: The loop's max is the ceiling on how many versions this node registers in one tick, and the roster query has no LIMIT: past it the loop ends as a normal completion and the versions after it are never registered here, so every match they are paired into is released by this node for ever. A warn line is the only signal, since a cron occurrence's data returns nowhere; raise the loop's max (under [engine] max_loop_iterations) when it fires.
